name: cogentstack
description: Connect isolated AI project contexts to CogentStack Web through one account-bound Desktop Bridge, restore portable Git-backed knowledge, and execute approved local actions.

interface.shortDescription: CogentStack Web, one Bridge, isolated AI contexts.
interface.longDescription: CogentStack keeps official ChatGPT, Codex, and Claude desktop applications independent and connects their isolated project contexts to CogentStack Web through one account-bound Desktop Bridge. Invoking CogentStack resolves the current stable project context, starts or reuses its quiet Bridge worker, and returns the exact web workspace link without opening a browser, creating tabs, inspecting unrelated pages, hiding sidebars, or resizing windows. Approved project creation, permanent deletion, and verified local-preview requests are queued by the hosted workspace and executed through narrow server-authoritative helpers. Qwen Desktop remains an optional CogentStack-owned integrated local, cloud, and hybrid workspace and includes the same Bridge rather than installing a second copy. Portable Git-backed project knowledge supports continuity across AI projects and computers while protected contracts, execution grants, licence validation, and subscriber data remain on the CogentStack service.
